summary: This bill amends the Food, Conservation, and Energy Act of 2008 to allow agricultural producers to use storage facility loan funds for constructing or upgrading propane storage facilities primarily used for agricultural production.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the eligible uses for existing storage facility loan programs to include propane storage for agricultural production.
